sources.observation: The west elevation shows the large tracery window, twin towers and Bell Harry’s paired openings and corner pinnacles. The roof wings have distinct grey-blue ridges.
Pilasters and horizontal stone bands divide Bell Harry’s shaft. The south transept and aisle chapels project below the two roof ridges.

limitations: Exterior window surrounds and tracery are modeled at viewing scale. Ornamental carvings, changing conservation scaffolding and interiors are outside the model scope.
